title: 水の出口
time: 召喚当日・昼から夕方
change: 孤立したコウが、食堂で最初の仕事と食事を得る。排水の詰まりを直すが、作物の回復はまだ確認できない。
state: 三階へ召喚。帰還門は調査中。エルナの区画で修理許可を得る。枯れた株は回復しない。
scenes: One tall borderless vertical scene: Kou startled and unsteady on the paved lane at the top; his eyes follow immense pale sandstone ribs to the glowing ceiling; downward motion returns to his dirt-stained hands and green apron. Tower interior only, NOT open outdoor sky. He remembers farming but no Earth scene. Two separate moments, not duplicate simultaneous people.

Three unequal panels: medium Kou facing a plain wooden administrative desk; closer offscreen clerk's hand indicating a closed stone gate diagram without lettering; closeup Kou absorbing the answer. Clerk is an ordinary older adult in beige robe, not Leon. Show patient exchange, hope and worry.
帰還の門は、今は閉じてる。
帰る方法は、あるんですね？
調査待ちだ。まずは寝床だ。

Wide panel: Kou pauses outside diner blue awning, hungry, Elna at serving window to his left. Small inset of his hand on stomach. Lower medium panel of Elna turning toward vegetable plot. Keep paved lane left and beds right of diner.

Three unequal panels in the same plot: wide Elna left and crouching Kou right beside wilted broad leafy vegetables; closeup her tense hand holding a small fertilizer sack closed; lower closeup Kou pressing moist soil, not pouring water. Water remains pooled, drain is still blocked.
水も肥料も、増やしたのに。
この土、ずっと湿ってる？

Two medium panels with a narrow hand closeup between: Kou gently exposes one small plant's roots with a trowel; dark compact wet root zone and some damaged roots, no instant healthy glow; Elna silently watches and responds to his cautious expression. Exactly one dug plant, nearby plants remain rooted.
葉より先に、根を見たい。
悪い場所も、残して比べよう。

Three unequal conversation panels at removable wooden drain inspection cover near plot edge: Kou asks while pointing at cover; Elna with diner blue awning behind answers; their hands reach for the same cover after permission. Drain not flowing yet, leaves and silt block its opening.
この出口、誰が管理してる？
店の区画は、私が掃除する決まり。

One tall flowing composition plus two small unequal hand closeups at the top: Kou removes leaf litter and silt from accessible outlet, Elna holds lifted cover aside; clear visible flow then follows the channel downward and out safely to common drain. No digging through structural wall, no flooding other houses, wilted plants remain wilted. The visible action causes the flow.

Three panels with final large warm scene: Elna sets a steaming barley-and-meat bowl on diner counter for Kou; closeup his rough hands near the bowl as he looks worried toward the still wilted garden; final Elna's gentle expression and Kou's relieved face in warm kitchen lamplight. Vegetables and grain are already purchased or existing, not newly grown. No miraculous lush plot.

title: 救える畝、残せない畝
change: 待つことと比較を学び、救えた既存の成株を料理へ渡す。失った区画を受け入れて次作へ進む。
state: 排水は動く。新しい根は数日後に一部で確認。株数と収量をまだ保証しない。バルトが現地の知識を渡す。
scenes: Same garden at early light, two unequal panels: Kou examines yesterday's marked wilted plant still rooted, Elna behind him with empty watering can set down; closeup his cautious face and wet ground beginning to dry. No recovered jungle overnight.

Wide Balt arrives on walking path in brown hat; separate closeup Balt observing marked plant; lower Kou listens. Balt is experienced and practical, not foolish. Dug plant from yesterday lies separately and is not replanted alive.
抜いた株は、元には戻らん。

Overhead plot with one marked comparison strip and other rows; hand closeup tying plain twine marker without cutting roots; Elna looking from changed strip to remaining area. Plants vary realistically, no flashy transformation.
この列だけ、別に記録する。

Two unequal panels: Kou writes simple marks and blank spaces in notebook at plot edge; closeup Elna reading over shoulder. A subtle empty translucent recording frame may hover but NO added visible text or numerical claims. Notebook has sketch marks only.
知らない数字は、空欄でいい。
分かったことだけ、残せ。

Time has advanced to day five. Three panels: same twine marker and modestly less wilted plant, gentle root inspection showing a few NEW white fine roots amid remaining damaged roots, Balt's restrained pleased expression. Recovery is partial, no instant glow or giant growth.

Large quiet panel of bare damaged strip where dead plants have been removed, Elna kneeling with sad face; lower Kou quietly placing tray to plan new sowing. Do not fill dead area with new mature plants.
こっちは、戻らないのね。

Three unequal shots: Balt shows a surviving mature garden-leaf plant; Kou cuts usable leaves gently into clean shallow basket; Elna checks leaf size for kitchen. Source is surviving established plants, not seeds sown in this story.
この葉は、若いうちが柔らかい。
切りやすい大きさが、欲しい。

Warm kitchen: basket passed from Kou's hands to Elna, narrow chopping closeup, large finished steaming dish at counter and their faces. Keep raw garden work off cooking surface. No magical buff display.
食べる人まで、畑の続きだね。

title: 一度に播くな
change: 人気への期待を作付けへ変える。十二区画の分割播種を始め、初収穫までは仕入れる。
state: 既存の成株を順に使い、復旧区画を播種。最初の庭葉は7日目に播く。28日栽培は見込みで確定値ではない。
scenes: Diner counter, young adult adventurer with auburn short hair and muted ochre cloak finishes bowl; Elna listens smiling then worried. Small inset empty leafy garnish plate. This recurring customer is not Leon.

Kou and Elna outside serving window, clean empty harvest basket in foreground; two unequal closeups basket and Kou's thoughtful face. Existing harvest has been used, garden cannot immediately replace it.
一度に採れたら、次は空く。
畑にも、仕込みがいるんだ。
Balt on plot path shows tiny native seed in palm, Kou listens close, lower panel glowing ceiling vein and differently shaded bed corner. Plain seed packet without labels.
庭葉は、光が弱いと遅れる。
ここで育つ速さを、測ろう。

Three brief closeups: handful of small seeds; Kou places an equal counted sample on damp cloth in shallow dish; notebook makes tally marks with room for future result. No sprouts already in newly set test, no predicted yield on screen.
全部の種が、芽を出すとは限らない。

Elevated plot view with FOUR long parallel beds, each divided into THREE equal subsections by small twine markers, total twelve sections; medium Kou and Elna looking at plain sketched plan. Bed widths consistent, no implausible giant farm. Leave words off diagram.
四つの畝を、十二に分ける。
七日ずつ、播く日をずらそう。

Three unequal hand-action panels: Elna makes shallow sowing line in prepared bed; Kou sows tiny seeds in one selected section; soil gently covers seeds. Only first three of twelve sections are sown this week; other sections stay bare or contain existing plants. No germination in same instant.

Diner back door, local farmer delivers basket of existing leafy vegetables, Elna and Kou accept and tally purchase. Distinct plain brown-clothed adult supplier, not main cast duplicated. Bought grain sack also visible.
最初の収穫までは、仕入れる。
その代金も、計算に入れよう。

Large quiet evening scene under blue awning, Kou and Elna beside notebook with four simple week columns and small drawings, no readable diagram text; tiny new sown beds visible through window at ground, no mature crop there. Their serious hopeful faces dominate.
明日の客と、四週間後の畑。

title: 低い桶は、嘘をつかない
change: イリスと給水設備を作る。流れることと、均一に配れることを分け、保守できる手順を残す。
state: 160L桶は独立した丈夫な架台。配水は最初、一列ずつ容器で量を測る。細い自動点滴を既製品として出さない。
scenes: Kou carries two manageable wooden water buckets along path, not over crop bed; small closeup blistered palm; Elna at diner kitchen doorway worried about empty prep table. Seedlings small, daytime.
水を運ぶだけで、午前が終わる。
仕込みにも、来てほしい。

Iris enters beside empty wooden tank and laid-out ceramic pipe segments; medium Kou faces her, lower her hand sketches tank above beds. Goggles on forehead, navy short hair. No modern PVC or electronics.
桶を上げれば、流れるよ。

Three practical construction panels: Iris checks tank and support sketch, Kou and Balt assemble braced thick timber free-standing platform, Elna sees strong diagonal bracing. Water tank is still empty until stand complete. Do not place 160kg on flimsy roof.

Three unequal closeups same elapsed test: different outlets pour into identical measuring cups, near cup contains more than far cup; lower Kou and Iris looking at difference. Tank only modest height, pipe has clear joints and accessible valves.
高さと、管の長さが違うから。

Iris points to simple wooden stopcock, Kou opens ONE bed section and measures delivered water; other sections closed. Hands and pipe physically coherent. Main outlet larger than tiny modern drip emitter.
一列ずつ開けて、量を測る。
壊れても、直せる形にしよう。

Two closeups and one face panel: removable mesh filter lifted from accessible housing, Elna rinses removable part in utility basin, Iris shows simple fitting. Irrigation tool cleaning not on food-prep surface.

Tall composition: small water spell lifts EXISTING water from source barrel to raised tank, luminous blue stream visibly connects both water bodies, source level falls; then valve sends stored water gently to one section while Iris lowers hand exhausted but satisfied. No conjured infinite water.
魔法は、桶に上げる時だけ。

Large warm scene: Kou crouches inspecting SMALL seedlings, water delivery controlled in one background section; lower Elna invites him at blue-awning diner, still modest plot, no broad mature crop. His hands relaxed.
空いた時間で、苗を見る。
それから、昼ごはんを作ろう。

title: 土は、点数じゃない
change: 黄化を単なる不足と決めず、土と水を分析。肥料の過剰と塩類の問題を学び、追加施肥を止める。
state: 回復した区画と黄化区画は別に採土。ECは同じ方法内で比較。未知の魔物粉は食用農地へ入れない。
scenes: Balt and Kou beside one SMALL seedling section with yellowing leaves, nearby section greener; Balt feels leaf then checks soil, no idiot expression or huge mature forest. Closed fertilizer sack behind them.
足りない色とは、限らん。
水と土を、別々に調べたい。

Three closeups: Kou collects soil at matched depth in affected section, Balt collects normal section separately, two sealed sample jars and a third water sample kept apart. Jars have simple colored twine, no readable labels.
同じ採り方で、比べよう。

Iris at workshop table with fantasy conductivity probe in glass reference vessel, mechanical needle gauge and standard sample, Kou observes. No digital electronics. Two panels showing reference then sample, separate test steps, no invented numeric text.
測り方が違えば、数字も違う。
器具の基準も、確かめよう。

Medium Iris interprets matched samples, narrow closeup high versus lower needle position WITHOUT readable numbers, lower Elna worried holding closed fertilizer sack. No visible salt crystals sprouting from plant or magical x-ray.
この区画は、塩類が多い。
肥料にも、塩が含まれるんだ。

Kou and Balt trace drainage outlet safely toward common channel, hand on site map with simple arrows, quiet conversation. Do not flush water through bed in this scene: they are checking capacity and destination first.
薄める前に、排水先を調べる。
流した分は、消えんからな。

Plain local trader offers CLOSED sack of powdered monster residue on utility lane far from food beds, Kou declines immediate use, Balt serious nearby. No corpse, gore, spreading powder, or instant fertilizer miracle. Three unequal panels.
何が入ってるか、まだ分からない。
試すなら、食用の畑と分けろ。

Closeup fertilizer sack stored closed on shelf, hand marks dated observation in notebook; lower Elna and Kou inspect unchanged seedling section and decide to wait. No instant green transformation, no flooding.
今日は、足すのを止める。
変わるまで、記録しよう。

Tall soft transition from small slow-growing seedlings under tower light to diner serving window at dusk, Elna lights lantern, Kou brings PURCHASED basket. Warm anxious faces, continuous stable garden geography.
待ってる間にも、店は開く。
畑だけじゃ、暮らせないな。

title: おいしいだけじゃ、店は続かない
change: 労働対価と固定費を残せる献立へ改める。味と商売を共同で決める。
state: 主食と肉、葉菜の多くは仕入れ。6銅貨定食の差引2.6は賃金や家賃を払う原資で純利益ではない。庭葉はまだ苗。
scenes: Warm diner kitchen, Elna cheerfully adds extra food to guest bowl, Kou next to small ledger looks concerned but kind. Two unequal panels bowl then faces. Do not imply new seedlings harvested.
Three hand closeups: purchased grain sack and meat basket invoice with abstract marks, seed packet and tool, Kou's worn hands. Elna listening beside counter, purchased produce basket visible.
自分の畑の野菜も、ただじゃない。
種と、働いた時間がある。

Top view six copper coins next to one meal, smaller closeup several expense piles and ledger sketch, lower Kou explaining to Elna. Exactly six sale coins in first view. NO readable text besides dialogue, no profit waterfall chart.
六枚もらって、全部は残らない。
Three intimate unequal conversation panels: Kou earnest at ledger, Elna surprised and thoughtful, Kou replies. Quiet kitchen after closing, table clean, no other speakers.
残りから、家賃と賃金を払う。
そこを削ると、続かない。

Elna and Kou choose two practical dishes on clean prep counter, one grain-and-meat bowl and one soup, shared ingredients laid separately. Small inset simple blank menu board without text. Do not display dozens of fancy dishes.
同じ仕込みで、出せるものに。

Unequal closeups: washed leaves chopped on designated board; Elna adds leaves LAST to steaming pan or pot; larger shoulder view her timing heat. Kou only assists by handing clean ingredients. Food moisture and steam appetizing, no magical fireworks.

Auburn-haired young adult customer in ochre cloak returns at counter with steaming dish; medium Elna listens smiling, lower Kou looks toward seedling plot outside. Same customer as episode three, not Leon.
次の帰りも、この席に来たい。

Large quiet partnership scene under blue awning: Elna writes small reservation list with abstract marks, Kou beside her holding crop notebook, small plot at dusk. Serious hopeful sense of limited but workable business.
畑に合わせて、数を決めよう。
売り切れも、先に伝える。

title: 収穫日は、約束できるか
change: 生育の遅れを見て大口注文を断り、小口一便と代替仕入れを提案する。レオンの信頼の入口になる。
state: 最初の播種から14〜21日。まだ収穫しない。28日見込みを確定日と呼ばない。36日目に十二食を三階集結所へ届ける候補。
scenes: Leon enters diner in navy cloak, scar on right eyebrow, no sword, supply notebook in hand; Elna and Kou behind counter listen. Two panels wider arrival then restrained serious face.
次の遠征に、二十食頼めるか。
決まった日に、同じ品質で。
Kou looks toward small green plot hopefully, Iris beside him holds observation notebook, medium face then narrow hand closeup calendar sketch. No harvested basket, plants still growing.
庭葉は、そろそろ採れるはず。
その『はず』、どこまで確か？
Same bed has visibly shadier corner under tower rib, plants in that section smaller; Balt points upward at shadow boundary, Kou measures a leaf gently. Two unequal closeups and one contextual view.
光が違う。日付だけじゃ読めん。

Kou and Elna at table with crop notebook, crossed-out estimate and alternative schedule shown only as abstract marks, closeup uncertain thoughtful Kou then Elna listening. No false exact harvest-day projection.
二十八日は、見込みだった。
遅れた場合も、計算し直す。
Three unequal conversation panels at diner: Kou honest serious, Leon watching without anger, Elna anxious then relieved. No humiliation or cartoon villain stance.
二十食は、まだ約束できません。
出せる数と、代わりの手を聞こう。
Elna negotiates with local produce supplier at back door, Balt nearby discusses existing stock, Kou checks ledger. Baskets represent supplier's mature crops, not main plot magically grown.
量と値段も、先に決めよう。

Two closeups and quiet medium panel: Kou carefully thins crowded SMALL garden-leaf seedlings, Elna holds tray for removed seedlings away from future food; path not trodden over bed. No harvesting immature plants for order.
今日は、この苗を間引く。
育つ場所を、残してやれ。
Large dignified scene in diner: Leon offers small plain contract, Kou and Elna accept together, modest vegetable beds seen outside. Hands coherent, no ornate reward trophy or huge coin shower.
まず、一便だけ。十二食だ。
畑も、仕入れも確認します。

title: 初めての、自分たちの収穫
change: 育てた庭葉が初めて料理になる。選別後の使える量を測り、次の納品へ渡す。
state: 第一播種の育った二区画、計8m²を収穫。遅い一区画は残す。使用可能量は約5.1kgという創作上の実測。全48m²を同時収穫しない。
scenes: First small mature leafy sections at day thirty-five, other later-sown sections still small, one shaded first section smaller; Elna crouches excited, Kou checks one leaf. Gentle morning tower light, no enormous vegetables.
一株、厨房で確かめよう。

Three unequal hand shots: clean harvest basket on path, Kou cuts garden-leaf crop above soil carefully, leaves placed gently without crushing or dirty roots. Elna watches. Only selected mature sections harvested.
土を、葉につけないように。

Elna and Kou sort leaves at designated utility table, usable irregular small leaves in one basket, damaged leaves separately in reject tray. Closeups genuine leaves and hands. Do not present rotten material as food.
重さと、使える分を分ける。
小さくても、使える葉はある。
Mechanical beam scale weighing baskets, Kou records simple tally in notebook, Elna sees modest harvest. No giant produce mountain; approximately five kilograms usable total across harvested sections.
使える分は、五キロほど。
まず、この量で考えよう。

Kitchen washed harvest transferred separately, Elna slices leaves to bite-sized pieces, Kou sets clean bowl; three different-size closeups and medium cooking view. Stable cream apron and blue headscarf.
この大きさなら、使いやすい。
食べやすい切り方にしよう。

Large borderless appetizing hero composition: steaming grain-and-meat bowl topped with bright freshly cooked garden-leaf greens, bowl near auburn young adult customer's rough hands, lower warm eager face before first bite. Food richly drawn, no added text except exact small speech balloon.

Three panels: customer enjoys first bite silently; closeup Kou's relieved face after weeks of waiting; Elna beside him with soft pleased expression. Calm adult emotion, no instant buff numbers. Diner warm, crop plot distant.
やっと、畑が皿になった。

Warm evening kitchen, Kou and Elna prepare clean containers beside remaining harvest basket, Leon at doorway confirms next morning delivery. No already-packed food stored overnight: preparation is containers and schedule.
採れた。次は、届ける番だ。

title: 十二人に届ける一便
change: 初の小口納品を、連絡と受け渡し変更で守る。単発成功と継続契約を分ける。
state: 十二食を三階の集結所へ。七階へ無検証の長距離配送をしない。料理は当日調理。供給は自家収穫と仕入れ。
scenes: Elna prepares twelve simple clean covered food containers on kitchen table, Kou confirms at ledger, background bought grain and meat with harvested leaves. Three panels cooking, lids, plan. No overflowing hundred-meal feast.
三階の集結所まで、十二食。

Two designated clean cooking pots, Elna points to kitchen-only utensils, small inset dirty irrigation buckets remain OUTSIDE on separate utility shelf; Kou wipes hands before touching packed food. Two unequal panels, no unsafe mixing.

Stone gate lane inside third floor, Kou with small covered handcart of food, local gate worker in beige points to waiting cargo queue, Elna worried. No fighting or sword attack, delay is transport coordination.
今日は、通行便が遅れる。
受け渡し場所を、変えられる？
Leon at nearby third-floor assembly entrance instructs assistant while Kou and Elna listen, short hand gesture showing safe nearby pickup location, clear geographical continuity and no gate bypass.
入口側で受け取る。連絡は俺がする。
その場所なら、間に合う。

One tall continuous scene of small handcart rolling down paved lane from diner toward visible nearby third-floor assembly arch, Elna walking beside Kou; closeup careful hands securing covered containers, no exposed food or magical flying cart.
鍋を持つ人も、攻略隊なんだな。
食べるところまでが、私たちの仕事。
Leon checks all twelve recipients and signs delivery note with abstract marks, closeup professional respectful face, Kou listening with Elna nearby. No vast gold payment or instant huge contract.
十二食、欠けずに届いた。
次は、続けられるかを見よう。

Three unequal panels in assembly courtyard: modest adult adventurer squad receives covered meals, one tired brown-haired swordswoman tastes hot greens and grain, relaxed smiles around low table. Weapons sheathed away from food. No wounded person magically healed.
今日は、ちゃんと飯を食えた。

Large quiet evening return to diner, empty cleanable containers and handcart, Kou and Elna sit on porch tired but satisfied. Plot not magically mature everywhere. Small lantern warmth under blue awning.
一便はできた。毎日は、これからだ。
今日は、この十二人分でいい。

title: 帰ってくる場所
change: 次の収穫と代替仕入れで16食の営業を続ける。共同経営の約束と保守手順を残し、上層の需要へつなぐ。
state: 第二播種の一部と遅れていた第一播種区画を収穫。全48m²の安定供給実績はまだない。16食は自給と仕入れを合わせた営業枠。
scenes: Same four beds with age-staggered sections: Kou and Balt harvest newly ready section while earlier harvested section is bare or freshly resown and younger sections remain smaller. Twine markers visible. Two hand closeups plus broad context.
次の区画が、つながった。
予定が、少し読めてきたな。

Elna at reservation ledger with sixteen simple small marks, Kou beside bought produce basket and own harvest; outside supplier acknowledges arrangement. Two unequal panels include limited supply clearly.
足りない時の仕入れも、決めてある。

Three intimate panels at clean diner counter: Elna earnest facing Kou, her hand placing shop key on table, Kou thoughtfully reaching to joint crop-and-menu notebook rather than seizing key. Adult respectful partnership.
畑と厨房、一緒に決めたい。
店の相棒に、なってくれる？
働く分も、きちんと分けよう。

Iris shows Elna how to open removable irrigation filter housing beside sturdy tank stand; Kou stands back listening, not doing every task. Closeups demonstrate same fitting as episode four; no modern gadgets.
詰まったら、ここを開ける。
直し方も、店に残しておく。

Balt and Kou beside small separate reserved seed-production strip of garden-leaf plants, a few plants left standing, NOT mature seed harvested already. Hand places plain marker, separate harvest basket for food.
この畝は、次の種を残す。
売る分だけじゃ、先へ続かん。

Large borderless warm diner entrance view: auburn young adult customer in ochre cloak returns slightly dusty from expedition, Elna smiles at serving window, empty familiar seat in foreground and hot meal ready. Kou assists quietly behind her, no duplicate character heads.

Kou and Elna share plain illustrated maintenance/crop notebook on porch, smaller montage Balt observing seedlings and Iris storing spare fitting; characters in separate successive frames, not simultaneously duplicated. Quiet achieved trust, no magical new world omniscience.
俺がいなくても、回るように。

Final large scene: Leon at blue-awning diner brings small parchment sketch of colder upper-floor outpost, Kou and Elna look toward distant ascending stone stairs. Warm kitchen foreground and cool stairway beyond establish future, not new farm already built upstairs.
七階でも、この飯を出せるか？
まず、畑と台所を見に行こう。
